title: Enterprise QnA + Evidence Mapping: SIEM Conversion Workbench (WIP)
body:
PURPOSE:
This is a working playbook for responding to enterprise security questionnaires (RFPs, security QnA spreadsheets) by mapping each ask to: the canonical evidence artifact, an automated extraction path (script / SIEM export), and a short pre-approved customer-friendly explanation. The goal: reduce manual evidence assembly time and make SIEM exports (Splunk/Elastic/Datadog) first-class outputs for auditors.

SCOPE:
- Questions types covered: RBAC design and enforcement, audit log coverage and retention, SIEM-ready export format, evidence provenance for customer questionnaires, and sample snippet artefacts.
- Outputs: mapping sheet, a small library of extraction helpers (bash/python), and example SIEM ingestion mappings.

AUDIENCE:
- Sales engineers responding to questionnaires
- Security & compliance reviewers
- Solutions engineering for SIEM onboarding

QUICK MAPPING (example rows)
1) "Explain RBAC model and show recent role-change audit evidence"
   - Canonical evidence: RBAC v2 design doc + role-change audit logs (audit-index-YYYY)
   - Extraction: scripts/evidence-extract/role_changes_last_90d.sh -> Splunk saved search 'rbac_role_changes' or Elastic query on 'event.action:role_change'
   - Customer text (one-liner): "Redwood enforces RBAC v2 with role-change events recorded to our immutable audit log; attached export shows role changes for the requested window."

2) "Provide proof of retention/configurable retention policy for audit logs"
   - Evidence: retention-config.yml + S3 lifecycle policy snapshot + retention-dashboard.png
   - Extraction: infra/scripts/export-retention-config.sh, attach S3 policy JSON
   - Customer text: "Audit logs are retained per customer SLA; retention is configured in infra and enforced via lifecycle policies. See attached policy snapshot."

3) "Do you export logs to customer SIEM? Format and mapping?"
   - Evidence: SIEM export config (kinesis->firehose->Elastic) and sample event exports
   - Extraction: tools/siem-export/sample_export_YYYYMMDD.ndjson
   - Customer text: "We support push and pull exports; attached is a mapping to Elastic Common Schema (ECS) and a sample NDJSON export."

AUDIT EVENT EXAMPLES (human-readable snippets)
- canonical single-line event (textified):
  2025-02-12T18:23:02Z | INFO | user=alice@example.com | action=role_assigned | role=dedicated_admin | actor=svc-account-role-sync | trace_id=abcd1234 | request_id=req-8742

- JSON sample we use internally (for SIEM example) -- included here as text for reviewers:
  {
    "@timestamp": "2025-02-12T18:23:02Z",
    "event": {"action": "role_assigned", "category": "iam"},
    "user": {"email": "alice@example.com", "id": "user-384"},
    "rbac": {"role": "dedicated_admin"},
    "agent": {"name": "rbac-service", "id": "svc-role-sync-1"},
    "aws": {"account_id": "123456789012"},
    "log": {"level": "info", "logger": "rbac.audit"},
    "trace_id": "abcd1234",
    "request_id": "req-8742"
  }

SIEM MAPPING - recommended (notes for SecOps)
- Elastic (ECS): map @timestamp -> @timestamp, event.action -> event.action, user.email -> user.email, rbac.role -> rbac.role (use namespace rbac.*), trace_id/request_id -> trace.id and event.id.
- Splunk: use fields: _time=@timestamp, user=..., action=..., sourcetype=redwood:audit, index=redwood-audit; create CIM-compliant aliases where possible.
- Datadog: send as JSON over logs intake with attributes.tagging: role, environment, customer_id; use service: rbac-audit and ddsource:redwood

EXTRACTION HELPERS (current hacks / prototypes)
- scripts/evidence-extract/role_changes_last_90d.sh  (Splunk savedsearch->CSV + sanitiser)
- tools/siem-export/ndjsonify.py  (converts newline-delimited logs to ECS NDJSON)
- infra/scripts/export-retention-config.sh  (grabs retention config from infra repo and S3)
- playbooks/prepare-qna-zip.sh  (zips artifacts, redacts PIIs, produces manifest.json)

CUSTOMER-FACING ONE-PAGER TEMPLATE (short)
- Header: Redwood Inference — Audit & RBAC evidence snapshot
- What we show: RBAC model overview, sample role-change logs, retention policy snapshot, export options to customer SIEM
- Where logs live: immutable audit-index (S3 + cold storage)
- How to request exports: contact se+security with timeframe and destination (S3/Elastic/Splunk)
- Timestamp & hash: include SHA256 of ZIP for tamper evidence

AUTOMATION CONSIDERATIONS / ISSUES FOUND
- Redaction: current scripts do naive redaction of emails and request_ids; need safer PII policy (Confluence doc linked).
- Consistency: field names differ slightly between services (rbac.role vs role) — we should standardise on ECS-like namespace.
- Access: non-admins occasionally need only a view of the evidence bundle without raw logs; provide a sanitized bundle pipeline.

SPLUNK SAMPLE QUERY (for role changes last 30 days)
index=redwood-audit sourcetype=redwood:audit event.action=role_assigned OR event.action=role_revoked | eval user=coalesce(user.email, user) | table _time user event.action rbac.role actor request_id trace_id | sort -_time

ELASTIC INGEST PIPELINE (notes)
- Pipeline should: parse timestamp, map event.action -> event.action, create ecs-compliant trace.id and event.id if missing, and tag source.customer_id. Use the ingest node to drop overly-large message fields before forwarding.

QUESTIONNAIRE-TO-EVIDENCE QUICKLOOK (common asks)
- Q: "How do you detect privilege escalation?" -> Evidence: alerting rules (detected-priv-esc.json), sample alert, SOC playbook link.
- Q: "Where are audit logs stored and who can access them?" -> Evidence: storage diagram + IAM policy export + last-90d access audit.
- Q: "Do you maintain immutable logs?" -> Evidence: S3 write-once lifecycle + KMS key rotation policy.

RISKS & OPEN QUESTIONS (action items)
- Who signs off on releasing sanitized role-change exports to prospects? (owner: Priya)
- We need a canonical column list for exported CSV/NDJSON across providers — propose owners: Zoe (Splunk), Liam (Elastic).
- Confirm legal on retention disclosure language for EU customers (linked_artifacts: JIRA-SEC-4321).

NEXT STEPS / ACTIONS
- [Zoe] Draft a standardized ECS mapping YAML and push to infra repo by 2025-03-10.
- [Liam] Harden redaction script to support regex allowlist by 2025-02-28.
- [Priya] Prepare a pre-approved one-pager template for SEs and attach in next week.

ATTACHMENTS & SAMPLE FILES (for packaging)
- sample_role_changes_20250212.ndjson (redacted)
- retention-policy-snapshot-2025-01-10.json
- rbac-v2-design-summary-2024-11-03.pdf
- playbooks/siem-export-readme.md

NOTES (meta)
- This is intentionally operational and pragmatic — not the final legal wording. Use the pre-approved customer text snippets above when assembling responses; route any legal/contract-level wording to security@redwood.com.

END OF WIP PLAYBOOK
